name: Synergix
description: The world's first AI on BNB Greenfield DCellar. Decentralized collective intelligence — every answer is grounded in community knowledge stored permanently on-chain. Ask questions, explore on-chain knowledge, get token info, and interact with the Synergix reputation system.

skills.name: Ask Synergix
skills.description: Ask a question to Synergix's RAG engine backed by BNB Greenfield collective knowledge. Returns AI-generated answers grounded in community contributions stored on-chain.
examples: How does the Synergix rank system work?
What makes Synergix unique among AI agents?

skills.name: Rank System
skills.description: Get the complete Synergix 6-tier on-chain reputation system with point thresholds, multipliers, and daily limits.
examples: Show me the Synergix rank table
What are the ranks in Synergix?
How many points do I need to reach Oráculo?

skills.name: Token Info
skills.description: Get $SYNERGIX token details: contract address on BNB Chain, tax structure, and how 1% buy/sell tax funds Greenfield storage.
examples: How does the Synergix tax work?
Tell me about the SYNERGIX token

skills.name: Greenfield Bucket Info
skills.description: Explore the Synergix BNB Greenfield bucket — the on-chain storage powering the AI. Shows bucket structure, paths, and the RAG engine architecture.
examples: What is in the Synergix Greenfield bucket?
How does Synergix store knowledge on-chain?

skills.name: Network Stats
skills.description: Get global Synergix network statistics: RAG engine status, federation loop, supported languages, and system health.
examples: What are the Synergix network statistics?
How many languages does Synergix support?
